description: This test file verifies the functionality of configuration accessor functions related to WhatsApp settings, focusing on merging, resolving, and formatting configurations such as allowFrom entries and defaultTo values.

methods.name: resolveWhatsAppConfigAllowFrom
methods.description: Resolves the 'allowFrom' configuration for a given account, merging default and account-specific entries.

methods.name: resolveWhatsAppConfigDefaultTo
methods.description: Resolves the 'defaultTo' configuration for a given account, providing the appropriate default channel or chat.

methods.name: formatWhatsAppConfigAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Formats and normalizes a list of 'allowFrom' entries, standardizing phone numbers and special symbols.
